tests.name: the page loads the boot recovery script
the boot recovery script is served as JavaScript, never the SPA fallback
a missing /assets/ file is a 404, not the app page
boot-recover.js rules, nginx no-store rule, script order
tests.reason: Pins the reload rules (2/10/45 s, cap, same-origin /assets/ only, not after mount, no storage = no reload) and the nginx/index.html guarantees. The no-store header and the CDN cache result are checked by scripts/ci/verify-rollout-guarantees.sh in the staging deploy workflow, because the http runner cannot read headers.
